name: Task

name: Agent

name: BashOutput

name: TaskOutput

name: KillShell

name: TaskStop

name: TaskCreate

name: TaskGet

name: TaskUpdate

name: TaskList

name: EnterPlanMode
note: Recording a plan does not change the enforced agent mode. User/app mode transition remains separate.

name: ExitPlanMode
note: Present plan and request a decision; a response must not be treated as a permission or mode change that the host did not apply.

name: EnterWorktree
note: Git worktree creation/selection requires authorized Git operations and explicit workspace routing; files alone provide no isolation.

name: ExitWorktree
note: Workspace return and disposal are host lifecycle actions; do not silently delete or switch worktrees.

name: LSP
note: Compiler/search or an installed language-server client can approximate tasks; no native LSP protocol or unsaved-editor-state equivalent.

name: ListMcpResourcesTool
note: Translate server/resource IDs and pagination; templates are a separate SoAI tool.

name: ReadMcpResourceTool
note: Translate server and URI, then preserve content type and resource ownership.

name: MCPSearch
note: Historical deferred-tool discovery name. SoAI exposes selected tools but has no matching catalog-search/load MCP tool.

name: ToolSearch
note: Discover only tools actually available in the SoAI conversation. Tool discovery/loading requires adapter work, not a web search.

name: WaitForMcpServers
note: Connection readiness belongs to SoAI MCP lifecycle; no matching model-callable readiness waiter.

name: SendMessage
note: Cooperative shared-workspace mailbox can exchange text. It cannot natively inject into a running agent, wake/resume idle agents or reach other sessions.

name: ListAgents
note: A maintained agent manifest can list agents the adapter launched; no native global/cross-session agent directory.

name: TeamCreate
note: Historical experimental team setup can become a shared workspace manifest. This does not create native team lifecycle semantics.

name: TeamDelete
note: Historical team teardown needs terminal-state reconciliation; deleting a manifest does not stop workers.

name: SubagentHandback
note: SoAI already collects child final results, but does not reproduce Claude auto-mode report classification or its explicit handback call.

name: Workflow
note: Parent-driven orchestration is possible; no matching script runtime, nested spawn or workflow checkpoint/resume contract.

name: Monitor
note: Tracked background scripts can monitor a source; arbitrary event injection and WebSocket-triggered agent turns need runtime support.

name: CronCreate
note: SoAI rejects cron expressions and supports none/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly/yearly recurrences; minute-level and arbitrary cron jobs do not map. Session scope also differs.

name: CronList
note: No automation-list MCP tool in the inspected catalog; a new operation or explicit UI/REST integration is required.

name: CronDelete
note: Disabling an automation can stop future runs; no deletion tool or identical session-cron contract.

name: ScheduleWakeup
note: A new scheduled run differs from resuming the same live session; wait only delays the current execution.

name: RemoteTrigger
note: Own-host scheduling/runs can replace the intent; Claude cloud task IDs, listing/deletion, credentials and execution environment do not transfer.

name: PushNotification
note: SoAI persisted WebUI notification exists. Do not claim Anthropic mobile/desktop push delivery.

name: SendUserMessage
note: Experimental primary-visible-output gateway. SoAI notification is not an assistant transcript message with file attachments.

name: Brief
note: Alias of SendUserMessage in the inspected runtime; same presentation and attachment gap.

name: SendUserFile
note: Create workspace deliverable and expose its authorized download; no matching remote-client file-transfer tool.

name: Artifact
note: Local HTML/Markdown deliverables are possible; publishing, sharing and versioning on claude.ai require that service.

name: ShareOnboardingGuide
note: Can write ONBOARDING.md locally. No Claude-hosted sharing/session-onboarding equivalent.

name: SendFeedback
note: Draft a local report; do not submit to Anthropic or any other destination without explicit authorization.

name: ReportFindings
note: Can produce structured findings as an artifact. No identical review-card rendering contract.

name: EndConversation
note: Can stop the SoAI conversation; source-host lockout/classifier semantics do not map automatically.

name: StructuredOutput
note: SDK-injected output-schema tool. Use a validated structured model response only if the selected SoAI request supports it; not a literal alias.

name: Sleep
note: Source-declared experimental sleep name; duration/cancellation conversion required. Runtime availability is conditional.

name: ListPlugins
note: Lists plugins enabled on the Claude account, not local SoAI backend plugins.

name: AskQuestion
